patch.value: Compare native and published crash recovery with a reusable kill corpus

Reusable TypeScript process-kill/restart differential SDK and command against the locked published oracle; compare acknowledged durable bytes, append-only histories and restart receipts on disposable plain-directory trackers.

Every declared crash boundary preserves acknowledged writes; failures retain minimized synthetic reproductions and never rewrite original history.; Typed SDK and CLI with bounded TOON/JSON receipts and actionable refusals; documented example; public tracker read-copy validation with measured counts; exact-head CI release-check passes.
